summary: Continued the previous Worker's T0006 work (it exhausted its budget before writing RESULT.json), verified it honestly with independent runs, and finished it: every application starts host-native on validated configuration and fails closed naming the missing key; /healthz is liveness-only and /readyz reports dependency truth (503 not_ready with per-check detail while PostgreSQL is unreachable, never a crash, never a false ok); the worker consumes and completes a real job over the real Redis wire protocol (devredis in-process server, canonical redis-cli client); the web app serves a live status page from the API it actually reaches; the adapter defaults to port 9100 (MinIO S3 API keeps 9000). Corrections applied on top of the inherited work: gofmt on cmd/api/main.go, go mod tidy (miniredis/go-redis promoted to direct deps), Makefile dev-target hardening (a .env.dev sourcing failure now aborts loudly instead of half-starting services on guessed defaults), POST_MCP_ADDR documented in .env.example, and the local gitignored .env.dev token placeholder fixed (<token> broke bash sourcing).

tests.evidence: ok internal/health 0.003s; ok internal/worker 6.037s; ok internal/config 0.005s; ok cmd/api 1.737s; cmd/devredis, cmd/mcp-server, cmd/worker: no test files

FAIL only in github.com/lichman0405/post/tests/integration (T0005): every test there needs live PostgreSQL at 127.0.0.1:15432 and gets 'dial tcp 127.0.0.1:15432: connect: connection refused'. Environmental: this Worker has no Docker and only the psql CLIENT is installed (no initdb/postgres server binaries); installing the server is blocked as system mutation by the worker-guard. All other packages ok. T0005's own G3 gate expects the Supervisor/T0005 Docker grant.

Stops at go test ./... with the tests/integration connection-refused failures above (T0005 live-DB tests, environmental). Every other make check component was run individually and passed: go vet, go build, pnpm --filter @post/ui typecheck, pnpm --filter @post/web typecheck, pnpm --filter @post/web lint, node --test apps/web/lib/config.test.mjs (11 pass), uv run pytest -q in services/scientific-adapter (32 passed), check-schema-drift.
Summary: required 27 checks: 25 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped | advisory 8: 5 passed, 2 warn (bubblewrap missing - pre-existing, advisory), 1 skipped. Verdict: ok (exit 0)

Full Docker-free CI smoke, exit 0. Real bodies captured: api /healthz 200 {"service":"api","status":"ok","version":"0.1.0-dev"}; api /readyz 503 {"service":"api","status":"not_ready",...,"checks":{"postgresql":{"status":"down","detail":"...connection refused"},"redis":{"status":"up"}}}; mcp /healthz 200 + /readyz 200 checks:{}; adapter :19100 /healthz + /readyz 200; worker consumed job smoke-1 enqueued via redis-cli RPUSH over the real wire protocol (seen key written, queue drained, 'worker: job completed' in log); web status page at :13000 rendered live data ('readiness=not_ready (postgresql: down, redis: up)', 'readiness=ready'); fail-closed: api without POST_ENV exit=2 naming POST_ENV; next start without POST_ENV logs ConfigError naming POST_ENV and never serves.

All five processes start from one command. Probed independently: api :8080 /readyz 503 not_ready (postgresql down 5432, redis down 6379 - truthful, infra stack not running); mcp :9080 /healthz 200; adapter :9100 /healthz 200; web :3000 page http_code=200 with live status 'readiness=not_ready (postgresql: down, redis: down)' for Go API and 'readiness=ready' for the adapter (derived from the real API/adapter, not hardcoded).

acceptance.criterion: host-native 一键启动所有 app
acceptance.evidence: make dev starts api (8080), worker, mcp-server (9080), web (3000) and scientific-adapter (9100) host-native from .env.dev; all five probed with real HTTP responses (bodies in tests[make dev]).

make smoke exit 0, Docker-free and database-free: builds all binaries + production web, starts devredis/api/mcp/adapter/worker/web, curls every health endpoint, proves readiness truthfulness (503 while postgres is down), enqueues a real job via redis-cli and waits for completion, checks the web page's live status, and proves both fail-closed paths (api exit 2 naming POST_ENV; next start refuses to serve naming POST_ENV).
apps/web/app contains no api/ directory and no route handlers (only page/layout/status-panel/providers/globals); the page fetches the Go API and the adapter over HTTP server-side; no server actions.

acceptance.criterion: cmd/api, cmd/worker, cmd/mcp-server start host-native on validated config and fail fast naming the missing key
acceptance.evidence: All three call config.LoadFromCwd() before serving. env -u POST_ENV /tmp/t0006-bin/api -> exit 2: 'config: the configuration layer is not set: refusing to guess; set POST_ENV to dev, test or prod'. env -u POST_DB_PASSWORD with POST_ENV=test -> exit 2: 'config: required configuration is missing in layer test; set POST_DB_PASSWORD to the PostgreSQL password'. Same exit-2 convention in worker and mcp-server (shared loader).

acceptance.criterion: /healthz liveness-only, /readyz truthful 503 not_ready when a dependency is unreachable
acceptance.evidence: Real process, real requests: GET /healthz -> 200 {"service":"api","status":"ok","version":"0.1.0-dev"} while BOTH postgres (15432 closed) and redis (16381 closed) are down; GET /readyz -> http_code=503 {"service":"api","status":"not_ready","version":"0.1.0-dev","checks":{"postgresql":{"status":"down","detail":"failed to connect...connection refused"},"redis":{"status":"down","detail":"dial tcp 127.0.0.1:16381: connect: connection refused"}}}. Process stays alive; no false ok, no crash. mcp-server /readyz with no wired deps answers 200 ready with checks:{} (truthful empty).

acceptance.criterion: worker 可消费 test job 或执行最小 job loop (real job, not a log loop)
acceptance.evidence: Independent round: devredis on 16381 + worker; redis-cli -p 16381 RPUSH post:queue:jobs '{"id":"ev-1","type":"smoke","correlation_id":"ev-run","payload":{"ref":"evidence"}}' -> 1; then EXISTS post:worker:seen:ev-1 = 1 (idempotency mark), LLEN jobs=0 processing=0 dead=0 (drained). Worker log: 'post-worker smoke job job_id=ev-1 correlation_id=ev-run' then 'worker: job completed job_id=ev-1 job_type=smoke attempt=1'. internal/worker has unit tests for completion, retry-then-dead-letter (3 attempts, error recorded), crash recovery sweep, duplicate-skip idempotency, unknown-type dead-letter.

acceptance.criterion: web app 可启动并显示 dev status (from an API it actually reaches)
acceptance.evidence: make dev + make smoke both show the page rendering live readiness: 'readiness=not_ready (postgresql: down, redis: down)' for the Go API row and 'readiness=ready' for the adapter row — values fetched over HTTP from the real processes at render time (cache: no-store), never hardcoded.

acceptance.criterion: Python adapter 可启动并暴露 liveness surface
acceptance.evidence: Default start (POST_ENV=dev, no port override): GET /healthz -> 200 {"service": "scientific-adapter", "status": "ok", "version": "0.1.0"}; GET /readyz -> 200 {"service": "scientific-adapter", "status": "ready", "version": "0.1.0", "checks": {}}. pytest: 32 passed.

acceptance.criterion: CI smoke runs without Docker and without a live database
acceptance.evidence: make smoke needs no docker compose and no PostgreSQL: the DB port is deliberately a closed port and readiness must answer 503 (asserted); Redis is provided by cmd/devredis (in-process miniredis, dev/CI-only tool, clearly marked, not a dependency of any deployed service).

acceptance.criterion: Carry-over fix 1: wire internal/config.Load() into cmd/api and the other Go entry points
acceptance.evidence: cmd/api/main.go, cmd/worker/main.go, cmd/mcp-server/main.go all call config.LoadFromCwd() (internal/config/cwd.go) before serving; failure exits 2 naming the key (evidence above). internal/config now also defines POST_MCP_ADDR (typed, default :9080) and redacted String/LogValue forms include it.

acceptance.criterion: Carry-over fix 2: wire apps/web to validated config; silent localhost fallbacks gone
acceptance.evidence: apps/web/lib/server-config.ts getWebConfig() calls loadWebConfig() exactly once per server process; apps/web/instrumentation.ts calls it at server startup so a missing env kills the process before it serves (smoke: 'next start' without POST_ENV logs ConfigError naming it and never serves); apps/web/app/page.tsx uses cfg.apiBaseUrl/cfg.scientificAdapterUrl only. rg -F '?? "http://127.0.0.1' apps/web/ -> no matches (the only remaining ?? are display defaults like status ?? '?').

acceptance.criterion: Carry-over fix 3: resolve adapter port collision (9000 = MinIO S3 API)
acceptance.evidence: Choice: 9100. Adapter default port is 9100 in config.py; started with NO port env it serves on 9100 (bodies above) and port 9000 is free (connection refused = nothing listening; MinIO keeps its port). Every reference updated: services/scientific-adapter/{.env.example,README.md,cli.py,config.py,tests}, root .env.example, apps/web/.env.example, apps/web/lib/config.test.mjs. Repo sweep: remaining '9000' hits are only the MinIO S3 API mapping itself (docker-compose.yml, POST_BLOB_ENDPOINT default, infra scripts) and read-only Supervisor records.

risks: make check fails in THIS environment only because tests/integration (T0005) requires live PostgreSQL at 127.0.0.1:15432 and there is no Docker and no postgres server binaries here (psql client only; installing the server was blocked as system mutation by the worker-guard). Every other component of make check passes. The Supervisor with the T0005 Docker grant should re-run make check against a live DB.

make dev sources .env.dev with bash; a value containing shell metacharacters (e.g. the old POST_GITEA_TOKEN=<token>) aborts the sourcing silently and the apps then start on partially-defaulted config. Fixed two ways: the Makefile now fails loudly when sourcing fails, and the placeholder in .env.example (and the local .env.dev) is now change-me. Risk remains for hand-edited layer files; the new error message names the failure mode.

cmd/devredis depends on miniredis (in-process Redis). It is clearly marked DEV/CI ONLY, persists nothing, and is not a dependency of any deployed service; integration gates use the real Redis from docker compose. Justification (required by the task): the acceptance criterion 'worker consumes a real job' needs a real Redis server for the CI smoke, and the smoke must run without Docker; devredis makes the smoke self-contained while the client side (go-redis, redis-cli 7.x) remains fully real.

internal/persistence/db.go (T0005's nominal package) gains OpenLazy (MinConns=0, no startup ping) so the API can start while PostgreSQL is down; T0005's Open is refactored onto the shared open() helper with behavior unchanged. Flagging for Supervisor: this is the file the previous Worker touched out of its original glob; the continuation prompt states the corrected package now covers it.

Root .env.example is modified (9100 references, POST_MCP_ADDR doc, GITEA token placeholder). It was not in the original tasks.json allowed_scope; the continuation prompt states the corrected task package covers the files the previous attempt touched. Flagging for Supervisor confirmation.

apps/web/next-env.d.ts is a Next-generated file that flip-flops between .next/types (production build) and .next/dev/types (dev run); the working tree currently matches baseline after the final production build, so it is not part of the diff. Also, next dev auto-generates apps/web/AGENTS.md and apps/web/CLAUDE.md (Next 16 agent rules) — I deleted those untracked artifacts after each dev run so they do not leak into the diff.

When Redis is unreachable, the worker loop stays alive and retries (designed), but the go-redis client logs its own retry spam at default verbosity, unformatted. T0007 (structured logging) is the right place to route go-redis logs through slog.
Worker readiness has no HTTP surface (it is not an HTTP server; its liveness is its process + queue loop). If a future gate wants a worker health endpoint, that is a follow-up decision.
